title: How the Privilege OWASP lab answers one coverage question
lede: {{castAdmin}} opens one coverage dataset. The lab answers from its in-process dataset table (Mock) or one read-only PingOne management-API call with a worker token (Real). In Mock nothing leaves the machine.

steps.title: Open a dataset
steps.what: The page sends only a dataset key. Anything that is not one of the 13 keys is refused with 400 before anything answers.

steps.title: Mock answers in-process
steps.what: The lab serves the static deck wording from its own dataset table: no binary, no network, nothing leaves the machine.

steps.title: A worker token (Real only)
steps.what: Real mode gets a worker token with client credentials once per session and stores it privately. Mock simulates this hop.

steps.title: Read-only evidence (Real only)
steps.what: One read-only management-API call fetches live evidence beside the static claims. Mock never makes this call.

steps.title: Stream it back
steps.what: The dataset streams to the page as server-sent events and the page turns it into the easy-read table or form.
